description: This file contains the implementation of the main activity for an Android TicTacToe game app. It manages the game UI, including updating the game board, handling user interactions, and managing accessibility and state persistence.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity managing the TicTacToe game UI, user interactions, and game state rendering.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and attaches click listeners to game cells and reset button.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Persists the game state when the activity is recreated.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates the UI to reflect the current game state, including cell contents, colors, and accessibility descriptions.

methods.name: showResultSnackbar
methods.description: Displays a snackbar message indicating game result and offers a reset action.

methods.name: cellContentDescription
methods.description: Generates accessibility descriptions for each cell based on its value.

methods.name: announceForAccessibility
methods.description: Sends an accessibility announcement to assistive services.
